extName.description: Extension name in the manifest and the Chrome Web Store. Working name until the final name is chosen.

extDescription.message: Get a system notification when OpenAI resets the Codex usage limits. Unofficial; alerts come from codex-resets.com.
extDescription.description: Extension description in the manifest. At most 132 characters.

popupTitle.description: Text title at the top of the popup. Always plain text, never a logo.

alertsToggle.description: Label of the alerts toggle button. Its pressed state tells whether alerts are on.

alertsTurnOn.description: Action that turns alerts on: the welcome page button and the tooltip of the popup toggle while alerts are off.

alertsTurnOff.description: Tooltip of the popup toggle while alerts are on.

alertsTurningOn.description: Shown while alerts are being turned on.

alertsTurningOff.description: Shown while alerts are being turned off.

alertsEnableFailed.description: Shown when turning alerts on failed. Alerts stay off.

alertsDisableNotConfirmed.message: Alerts are off. The request asking Codex Resets to remove this browser failed: $REASON$
alertsDisableNotConfirmed.description: Shown when alerts were turned off locally but the unsubscribe request to codex-resets.com failed.

statusOff.description: Popup status line while alerts are off.

statusWaiting.message: Turned on $WHEN$. Waiting for the first alert.
statusWaiting.description: Popup status line while alerts are on and no alert has arrived yet. WHEN is a relative time such as "5 min ago".

statusLastAlert.description: Popup status line after an alert arrived. WHEN is a relative time; KIND is alertKindReset or alertKindWatch.

alertKindReset.description: Kind of the last alert: a confirmed reset. Inserted into statusLastAlert.

alertKindWatch.description: Kind of the last alert: a forecast, not a confirmed reset. Inserted into statusLastAlert.

statusCheckFailed.description: Popup status line when the last check for missed alerts could not reach codex-resets.com. DETAIL says why.

statusCheckFailedNoDetail.description: Same as statusCheckFailed when no reason was recorded.

statusMissedReset.message: Push did not deliver a reset (detected $WHEN$). This clears when the next alert arrives.
statusMissedReset.description: Popup status line after the check found a reset that push did not deliver.

statusFailing.message: Push alerts are failing ($WHEN$): $REASON$. This clears when the next alert arrives.
statusFailing.description: Popup status line for an alert failure that is not a missed reset, for example a failed registration.

backgroundToggle.description: Label of the control that asks for the optional background permission.

backgroundOnNote.message: Chrome keeps running after its last window closes, until you quit it.
backgroundOnNote.description: Shown while the background permission is granted.

backgroundOffNote.message: Without it, alerts can stop when the last Chrome window closes.
backgroundOffNote.description: Shown while the background permission is not granted.

backgroundDenied.message: Chrome did not grant the background permission.
backgroundDenied.description: Shown when the background permission request was denied.

backgroundLinuxNote.message: On Linux, your system may also ask you to allow Chrome to run in the background.

latestResetLabel.description: Label of the latest reset card in the popup.

viewAnnouncement.description: Link to the public post that announced a reset.

resetObserved.description: Shown instead of the announcement link when a reset has no public post.

noResetsYet.description: Shown when Codex Resets has no reset to list.

statsTotal.description: Statistic label: total number of resets tracked by Codex Resets.

statsAverageInterval.description: Statistic label: average number of days between resets.

statsSinceLast.description: Statistic label: days since the most recent reset.

recentResetsHeading.description: Heading of the list of the five most recent resets.

creditLink.description: Credit link to https://codex-resets.com, required wherever its data is shown. Keep the site name unchanged.

disclaimer.message: Unofficial. Not affiliated with OpenAI or Codex Resets.
disclaimer.description: Disclaimer shown with the credit link.

loadFailed.message: Could not load reset data from Codex Resets.
loadFailed.description: Error state of the popup when the public API is down or unreachable. Alerts keep working.

loadRateLimited.message: Codex Resets is limiting requests right now. Try again later.
loadRateLimited.description: Error state of the popup when the public API answered with a rate limit.

retry.description: Button that loads reset data again after an error.

welcomeTitle.message: Welcome to Reset Alerts for Codex
welcomeTitle.description: Title and main heading of the welcome page opened on install.

welcomeIntro.message: Get a system notification when OpenAI resets the Codex usage limits, without keeping a website open.
welcomeIntro.description: First paragraph of the welcome page.

welcomeSource.message: Alerts come from Codex Resets (codex-resets.com), a separate site that tracks Codex usage limit resets. This extension shows its alerts as notifications.
welcomeSource.description: Welcome page paragraph that names the source of the alerts.

welcomePrivacyHeading.description: Heading of the welcome page section that explains what is sent.

welcomePrivacySubscription.message: Turning on alerts sends a push subscription to codex-resets.com: an address for this browser at its push service, with the keys that encrypt each alert. Turning off alerts asks Codex Resets to remove it.
welcomePrivacySubscription.description: Consent text on the welcome page, shown before the Turn on alerts button.

welcomePrivacyData.message: The popup also loads public reset data from codex-resets.com. There is no account, analytics or tracking.
welcomePrivacyData.description: Welcome page paragraph about the other requests the extension makes.

welcomeAlertsOff.message: Alerts stay off until you turn them on.
welcomeAlertsOff.description: Welcome page note next to the Turn on alerts button.

welcomeEnabled.message: Alerts are on. You can close this tab.
welcomeEnabled.description: Shown on the welcome page after alerts were turned on.

welcomePopupHint.message: Open this extension from the Extensions menu in the Chrome toolbar to see recent resets or change your alerts.
welcomePopupHint.description: Welcome page hint about the popup.
